Management Plan

- Summary of key actions and recommendations:
  - Analgesia: advised starting ibuprofen for suspected migraine/tension-type headache (dose/route/frequency not documented). Paracetamol may be continued; patient had taken paracetamol this morning.

  - Occupational advice: consider time off work (self-certify; suggested up to one week) to reduce stress.
  - Mental health support: advised exploring local counselling service; clinician to provide link for self-referral.
  - Safety advice: provided patient with link/note about danger signs for headaches to prompt earlier medical review if needed.
  - Follow-up: arrange GP follow-up in one week; earlier contact advised if symptoms worsen or new concerning features develop.
  - Contingency: if no improvement at follow-up, consider blood tests and further assessment/investigations.
